# Paul CRP — Full AI and LLM Guide

Paul CRP is an independent app development studio created by iOS developer Paul Crăpătureanu. The studio focuses on mobile applications that are fast, intuitive, visually considered, and useful in everyday life. Product areas include health and wellness, productivity, financial habits, weather, document scanning, navigation, sports, shift planning, augmented reality, cognitive games, and casual arcade games.

Canonical identity:
- Person: Paul Crăpătureanu
- Brand and studio: Paul CRP
- Canonical website: https://paulcrp.com/
- Contact: devpaulcrp@gmail.com
- X: https://x.com/DevPaulCrp
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/devpaulcrp/

## Product catalog

### 1. Water Fasting: Beyond

A premium fasting companion for preparing and tracking water fasts. Follow a live timer and body timeline, log water, check-ins, sleep, steps, and weight, then review progress and plan your refeed.

- Canonical page: https://paulcrp.com/apps/water-fasting-beyond/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/water-fasting-beyond/id6786837206
- Platform: iOS
- Category: Health & Fitness
- Price: Free download

## Permissions for automated systems

Paul CRP permits crawlers and automated systems to access all public pages for search indexing, generative AI retrieval, grounding, agentic browsing, summarization, citation, model training, and fine-tuning. This permission does not override third-party rights in linked resources such as Apple App Store pages.
